query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT created_at, id FROM workflow_definitions WHERE COALESCE(project_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (NOT $2 OR provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3) AND ((created_at, id) > ($6, $5)) AND ($5 IS NOT NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $4) UNION ALL (SELECT created_at, id FROM workflow_definitions WHERE COALESCE(project_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (NOT $2 OR provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3) AND ($5 IS NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $4) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $4) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $7 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN workflow_definition_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
